content_sections.heading: About the District Health Society, Tenkasi
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Health Society (Tenkasi District), Department of Public Health and Preventive Medicine. The posts are vacant at the Tenkasi District Headquarters Government Hospital, the District Siddha Medical Office, Government Primary Health Centres, Urban Primary Health Centres, Urban Wellness Centres and sub health centres. They are filled temporarily on contract under the National AYUSH Mission and the National Health Mission. The notice is signed by the Secretary, District Health Society and District Health Officer, and by the District Collector, Tenkasi.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice prints a total of 28 vacancies. Category-wise reservation is not printed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The table gives each post's qualification as printed, with the age limit as on 31 October 2026. District Programme Manager (Ayurveda): exposure to social sector schemes / Missions of Government at national, state and district level and knowledge of computers including MS Office, MS Word, MS Excel would be desirable. Preference will be given to persons having PG qualification in AYUSH stream and experience of working in the health sector including AYUSH. ECHO Technician: preference may be given to candidates having relevant practical experience in Echocardiography services in Govt. or recognised healthcare institutions. District Programme Coordinator: preference will be given to those who have worked in the field of Development / Health at District / State level. The age limit is counted as on 31 October 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

The notice names no documents to enclose and gives no email address, phone number or interview schedule.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Tenkasi District Health Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice prints a total of 28 vacancies across 14 posts. The largest numbers are 9 for Health Inspector Gr-2 (MTM), 4 for Hospital Worker and 3 for Auxiliary Nursing Midwife.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are received until 5 PM on 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from the Tenkasi district website, Recruitment section, and submit it in person or by Speed Post to the Secretary, District Health Society and District Health Officer, District Health Office, Government Primary Health Centre Campus, Ilathur - 627 803.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is up to 59 years for AYUSH Medical Officer, AYUSH Doctor and District Programme Manager (Ayurveda), and up to 40 years for the other posts, as on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Monthly pay ranges from Rs.11,000 for Hospital Worker to Rs.40,000 for AYUSH Medical Officer, AYUSH Doctor and District Programme Manager (Ayurveda), as printed for each post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Hospital Worker?
faq.answer: The notice requires 8th pass for Hospital Worker. There are 4 vacancies and the pay is Rs.11,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for Auxiliary Nursing Midwife?
faq.answer: Candidates need an 18-month (before 15.01.2012) or 24-month (after 15.01.2012) Multipurpose Health Worker (Female) / Auxiliary Nursing Midwife training, and registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice states the posts are purely temporary (11 months), on contract basis, and that service will not be made permanent at any time.

faq.question: Q9. Which scheme are the posts under?
faq.answer: The vacancies are under the National AYUSH Mission and the National Health Mission, in Tenkasi district health facilities.
